entities.name: Dušan Salfický
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Dušan Salfický is a Czech former professional ice hockey goaltender. He was drafted 132nd overall by the National Hockey League's New York Islanders in the 2001 NHL Entry Draft but only played 4 games for the Islander's American Hockey League farm team, the Bridgeport Sound Tigers.
